title: Sassafras: Small Angle Scattering Structure- and Form-factor Rapid Assessment
description:
A lightweight SANS/SAXS quick-look tool for the beamline: load reduced 1D data in any format sasdata reads, overlay a sasmodels form factor (optionally times a structure factor) with live sliders, chi-squared and residuals, refine with BUMPS, fit several datasets jointly with shared and constrained parameters, suggest a model from a curve library or neural network, and export IQuana notebooks.

The prebuilt curve-library indexes used by the Guess button are not in this archive; they are derived from SAS-55M-20k (MIT) and are downloaded with python -m sassafras.library fetch.
